card.title: The Fast and the Flourious
card.pitch: A pizza portal delivers one hero a custom pizza-throwing weapon.
card.visualHook: A glowing oven-red circle erupts into a pixel pizza launcher and flying pizza slices.
acceptance: On deploy and via !pizza, show a telegraph immediately; after 30 ticks equip one available hero with the custom pizza-projectile weapon.
After 150 ticks, show a celebratory impact ring; the equipped weapon remains in place.
If no hero is available, show the telegraph and aftermath without equipping anyone. Limit activation to once every 10 seconds.
card.feasibility: Define a hero weapon and pizza projectile; use scheduled effects and bounded hero selection.
card.risk: Low: affects at most one hero per activation; no temporary equipment restoration is required.
